parameters.content:
## Confirm store orders from wallet transfers

### How it works
The Qersh app on the merchant's phone posts every incoming wallet transfer (Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash, e& money, InstaPay) to the Webhook node as a signed JSON delivery; the Code node checks the signature on the raw body and refuses anything else with 401. For a new transfer the workflow asks your store for the open orders of that payer, matches the transfer to the order that was open when the money arrived (payer and time decide; the amount only chooses between that payer's orders), marks the order paid in the store and answers the phone with {"status":"matched","reference":"ORD-…"}. A later "suspected forgery" verdict stops the order. Your store stays the source of truth and keeps the delivery_id to answer repeats.

### Setup
1. In **Settings**, replace the placeholder with the connection key the phone shows after you add the wallet (paste it only here).
2. In Settings, set store_base_url. Your store offers three small endpoints: GET /qersh/open-orders?payer=… returning {"orders":[{order_number, price_minor, paid_minor, payer_key, created_at, expires_at}]}, POST /qersh/mark-paid and POST /qersh/stop-order. Add the store's authentication to the HTTP Request nodes with an n8n credential, never a key in the URL.
3. Activate the workflow and copy the Webhook node's **Production URL** into the Qersh app (More, Wallets, Add wallet, "your store URL"). "Test connection" on the phone must say the signature was verified. Self-hosted n8n needs `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` for the Code node; n8n Cloud allows it.

### Customization tips
Tune the match node's windows (late 120 minutes, skew 10 minutes). Alert someone from the "review" branch. Keep "Send sender details" on "full name and number" in the wallet, or the payer arrives masked and nothing matches.

Qersh (Qersh Pay) is a wallet notification relay, not a payment service provider. Docs: https://qersh.cfd/en/integrations/n8n

## Verify and route
The Code node checks the signature; Settings holds the key and your store URL; the If nodes pick the branch.

## Match and confirm
Your store returns the payer's open orders; the match picks the one open when the money arrived; the store marks it paid; the phone gets the result.

## Forgery verdict
transfer.updated with suspected_forgery: the store stops the order that transfer paid.

## Connection key inside the workflow
This template keeps the key in the **Settings** node, so it is part of the workflow JSON: do not export or share this workflow. The Qersh community node keeps the key in an encrypted n8n credential instead.
